entries.en: Claude automatically saves useful context to auto-memory. Manage with /memory
entries.zh: 克劳德自动将有用的上下文保存到自动记忆中。使用/内存进行管理

entries.en: Added `/copy` command to show an interactive picker when code blocks are present, allowing selection of individual code blocks or the full response.
entries.zh: 添加了`/copy`命令以在存在代码块时显示交互式选择器，从而允许选择单个代码块或完整响应。

entries.en: Improved "always allow" prefix suggestions for compound bash commands (e.g. `cd /tmp && git fetch && git push`) to compute smarter per-subcommand prefixes instead of treating the whole command as one
entries.zh: 改进复合 bash 命令（如 `cd /tmp && git fetch && git push`）的“始终允许”前缀建议：按子命令分别计算更精确的前缀，而不是把整条命令当成一个整体

entries.en: Improved ordering of short task lists
entries.zh: 改进短任务列表的排序

entries.en: Improved memory usage in multi-agent sessions by releasing completed subagent task state
entries.zh: 改进多 agent 会话的内存占用：释放已完成子代理的任务状态

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth token refresh race condition when running multiple Claude Code instances simultaneously
entries.zh: 修复了同时运行多个 Claude Code 实例时的 MCP OAuth 令牌刷新竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed shell commands not showing a clear error message when the working directory has been deleted
entries.zh: 修复了删除工作目录时 shell 命令不显示明确错误消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed config file corruption that could wipe authentication when multiple Claude Code instances ran simultaneously
entries.zh: 修复了配置文件损坏，当多个 Claude Code 实例同时运行时可能会擦除身份验证
